full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff-respondents' case is that the suit land, schedule, "Kha" land, part of schedule "Ka" land, appertains to Taluk Fela Nyamat Fakhrunnessa Estate, a Waqf Estate, of which Jalaluddin Ahmed Miah was Mutwali. Jalaluddin settled with Syed Ahmed Miah, predecessor of defendant Nos. 4-11 schedule "KA" land in rayati right for 5 years by a registered kabuliyat dated 19.5.44, Ext.2 Jalaluddin then sold out his superior interest therein in favour of defendants No. 12, Mvi. Abu Taher Mia (respondent No. 15 herein) by a registered patta dated 8.8.52, Ext. 3, As cultivation was unprofitable, Syed Ahmed surrendered his tenancy in "Ka" schedule land by a deed of Istafanama dated 12.3.53 in favour of defendant No. 12, Ext.4, and made over possession to him. Defendant No. 12 and defendant No.13 (respondent No.16 herein) then became joint Mutwallis of Waqf Estate. They orally settled the suit `Kha' schedule land at a rental of Tk. 4.50 in rayati right in Falgoon, 1360 B.S. with the plaintiff, who has been possessing the same since then. The lease was affirmed by a Rafanama dated 3.9.68 Ext.1 between the plaintiff and the aforesaid joint Mutwallis. The plaintiff came to know that the aforesaid Syed Ahmed sold the `Kha' schedule land to Sekandar Miah, Predecessor of defendants Nos. 1-3 (present appellants) by a registered kabala dated 12.3.59 Ext. A. It is the plaintiff's case that Syed Ahmed had no saleable interest in `Kha' schdule land on 12.3.59. Kabala Ext. A was false, fraudulent and without consideration. The plaintiff also came to know that defendants Nos.1-3 filed a miscellaneous case in the 2nd Court of Munsif, Feni, under section 1/3A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act against defendants Nos.4-14 for correction of record of rights. They lost the case in the trial Court but won the appeal before the District Judge, Noakhali, in Title Appeal No. 217 of 1969. The plaintiff was not made a party in the said proceeding. The suit was for a declaration of title to the 'Kha' schedule land and also for a declaration that the judgment in the aforesaid title appeal was not binding on the plaintiff. The plaintiff also pleaded adverse possession in the plaint.
